verified_facts: Canadian communications company founded 1984; incorporated in Ontario; corporate HQ Markham, Ontario (US head office Sarasota, FL). Publicly traded on TSX (STC) and Nasdaq (SANG) since Dec 2021. (sangoma.com IR page; SEC 40-F FY2025)

Business communications platform provider: UCaaS, CCaaS, CPaaS, Trunking as a Service, video/messaging; sold cloud, hybrid, or on-premises; plus managed services (SD-WAN, network security, connectivity). (sangoma.com; SEC filing)
Primary developer and sponsor of the open-source Asterisk and FreePBX projects; grew via acquisitions incl. Digium (2018), Star2Star (2021), NetFortris, VoIP Innovations. (SEC 40-F; Wikipedia)
Scale: 2.7M+ UC seats, 100k+ customers, 40+ years on the market; nine years in Gartner UCaaS Magic Quadrant (as stated in FY2025 results PR, Sep 2025).
Fiscal year ends June 30; FY2025 results published Sep 2025; no dividends in last 3 years, retains earnings to pay down debt (SEC AIF FY2026).
Asked for in cultural brand terms: integrity, accountability, teamwork (Workable employer page).
